phasing_details.phase_detail: Phase 1 - Demolition and site wide below ground works
Phase 2 - Construction of buildings A & D
Phase 3 - Construction of Buildings B and C

description: Phased redevelopment of 1-6 Citadel Place including demolition and provision of residential uses (Class C3) and flexible commercial uses at ground floor (Class E) with associated landscaping, access, car parking and other works.Reconsultation for the following amendments:-Addition of seven (7) flats-Amendments to Building C facade, material selection, and removal of some winter gardens.-Landscaping amendments
